component.name: Snek Studio
component.summary: Open-source VTuber software using Godot Engine!

description.p: SnekStudio is a free, open-source VTuber application written using the Godot engine!

VRM Support Use a standard model format shared across many tools and applications already. A MediaPipe-based Tracking System Capable of 50 different face blendshapes and hand tracking. VMC Receiver Support For those who would like to import real-time tracking data from other software. Modular Architecture Designed to be easily extended through self-contained modules written in GDScript, or just simple Godot scenes. Twitch Integration Let your viewers throw stuff at your face for channel points! Twitch redeem functionality can be extended in GDScript for other actions. Fully Open-Source It's free! And you can modify it! Linux Desktop Support Built to fill a gap in the VTubing space, which previously excluded most Linux desktop users.

description.p: Wooo another long time coming release! We've not really had a lot new features until recently when @copygirl did a big push to get a bunch of things merged. So without fruther adue, here's a list of things people have added or fixed!

ul.li: Add keybind functionality #120 (@Elliesaur)
The model controller won't error now when secondary model's are missing #148 (@PGComai)
Expose a slider for adjusting head pitch #153 (@PGComai)
Support pattern matching in Model Toggle #169 (@copygirl)
Fixed file filters not working in mods #166 (@the-furry-hubofeverything)
Added an explicit AI policy (@ExpiredPopsicle)
Updated the runtime for the flatpak #171 (@Lunarequest)
Add support for distributing mods as flatpaks #171 (@Lunarequest)
Added a giant throwable estrogen pill (@ExpiredPopsicle)
Updated flatpak resources based on the flathub review #179 (@Lunarequest)
Add a way to filter mods through Mod window #178 (@niri-havex)
Force shutdown the tracker process #180 (@leidenwolcloud)
Refactor settings code #181 (@leidenwolcloud)
Fix mod add window crashing when not filtering #182 (@copygirl)
Update TwitchGD4 and update to godot 4.7 @ExpiredPopsicle)
Various cleanups and refactoring @copygirl

description.p: This one has been a long time coming! Mainly because we've been waiting on Godot 4.6.2 to ship after we got the crash-on-exit bug fixed in it.
We're finally on 4.6! Also, mod toggles on/off, partial VRM 1.x support, and a whole lot of awesome new stuff from our contributors!

ul.li: Expose head position/rotating scaling options in MediaPipeController - CraftedCart
Added lipsync feature - Elliesaur
Transparent background is now the default
Mod_Base and children are now based on Node3D instead of Node - Kiri
Added VRChat OSC support - CraftedCart
Documentation! - Elliesaur
Added support for boolean blend shapes
Fixed an issue with BlendShapeScalingAndOffset values not saving
Alphabetized the mod window (finally)
Added options to the graphics tablet mod
Added right/left hand settings for the graphics tablet mod
Added anaglyph 3D module
Fixed a case sensitivity issue with the VMCController that was breaking blend shapes for some models
Added mouse-based head tracking module - Elliesaur
VMCSender support now fully implemented - AstroArchelon
Updated to Godot 4.6.2
Fixed a crash-on-exit bug in Godot
Added the ability to toggle mods on and off without fully removing them
VRM 1.x partial support added (no constraints yet)

description.p: Doing a release right before Offkai!
(Also because a bunch of stuff has been fixed since the last release.)
